metadata.othernotes:
Preliminary targeting guide:
- Aoi went to the same school as other Danganronpa characters such as Chiaki. She was in the same class as Kyoko and Chihiro.
- She is full of energy and stamina. Because of this, she considers her athletics to be a fundimental part of herself.
- She's also concerned that her extreme sweet tooth, particularly her love of eating donuts, is going to make her fat.
- Aoi can be quite air-headed and forgetful, relying on the memory trick of writing peoples' names three times on her hand in order to remember them.
- Due to being quite air-headed she can be easily manipulated by others and jump to conclusions or take them at face value.
- If you play on a background with water, Aoi will go for a swim a few turns after her forfeit.

case.name: Running Like Crazy
case.description: If the background has water, Aoi will go swimming.

case.name: New Record
case.description: Aoi hasn't stripped for 15 rounds. She asks if that's a new record.

case.name: Same Voice
case.description: This is a joke about how Aoi and Ringo were played by the same actor in English.

case.name: Last Place
case.description: Aoi asks if anyone feels good about finishing last.

This might be the end of my SPNATI chapter, but these past two years have been a lot of fun, and I feel like I've gotten even closer with several of my favorite characters. I'll keep updating Hina from here on as I'm commited to making her one of the best characters yet, and I hope you continue to enjoy playing as her and all the wonderful characters the inventory has to offer. Stay classy, Planet Earth.
